events.question: What business credit cards does Rho-Bank offer, including each card's annual fee, reward rates/categories, welcome or sign-up bonus, and spending caps?

facts_found: Rho-Bank business credit card products named in the knowledge base: Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, and Green Rewards Card (sustainable business card); a 'Business EcoCard' is also referenced as an eligible business card product. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Business Bronze Rewards Card has no annual fee (it is the listed no-annual-fee business card option). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008]

Business Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases, calculated on net transaction amount after credits or returns; rewards can be redeemed once the balance reaches $37, typically as a statement credit. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_002]
Business Silver Rewards Card normally earns 10.0% cash back on Travel and Software purchases and 1.0% on other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Silver Rewards Card limited-time offer: new customers who open the account between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14 earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after account opening (6-month window starts on account opening date); merchant category exclusions continue to apply and no separate enrollment is required. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]
Business Gold Rewards Card annual fee is $200.00 and APR on carried balances is 17.99%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]
Business Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on Operations spending and 1.0% cash back on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]
Business Gold Rewards Card initial credit limits start at $37,500 and may reach up to $225,000, subject to credit approval. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]
Business Gold Rewards Card eligibility requires minimum personal credit score 735 and minimum PAYDEX business credit score 67. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]

Business Platinum Rewards Card earns 4.0% when a merchant classifies the transaction as software or cloud services; all other purchases earn 1.5%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Business Platinum Rewards Card excludes hardware, peripherals, and on-premise equipment billed as physical goods from the 4.0% software/cloud rate (those earn 1.5%), as do professional services/consulting and non-software telecom or internet access charges. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Green Rewards Card (business) annual fee is $100.00, purchase APR 19.99%, foreign transaction fee 1.0%, and approved credit lines range from $14,000 to $75,000. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_001]

Green Rewards Card eligibility requires minimum personal FICO of 690 and, for established businesses, a PAYDEX threshold of 42; up to 15 employee cards can be issued with category-level controls. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_001]

Business Bronze, Business Silver, Business Gold, Business Platinum, and Green Rewards Card are cash-back cards whose backend 'points' convert at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or credit to a Rho-Bank checking account. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Credit card rewards are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole point on every purchase, across all cards and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Rho-Bank reward categories are Travel, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations (business operational expenses), Transportation (logistics, shipping, rideshare), Groceries, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Shopping, and Other (transactions falling under card-specific exclusions or exceptions). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]

Each Rho-Bank card has its own bonus categories at higher rates; purchases in non-bonus categories earn that card's default rate, and the category a merchant transaction falls into is determined by merchant coding. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019]

No welcome/sign-up bonus documentation was found for Business Bronze, Business Gold, Business Platinum, or Green Rewards Card; the only business-card new-customer incentive found is the Business Silver 2x cash back promotional period. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Card tier classifications used in internal policy docs: Business Bronze Rewards Card = Entry Tier, Business Silver Rewards Card and Green Rewards Card = Mid Tier, Business Gold Rewards Card = Premium Tier, Business Platinum Rewards Card = Elite Tier. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

events.question: Are motor vehicle or truck dealer purchases eligible for cash-back rewards on Rho-Bank business credit cards, and what reward category do such purchases fall into?

facts_found: Rewards/cash back are calculated based on the merchant category code assigned by the merchant's payment processor, and each card's bonus rate applies only when the merchant codes the transaction in a bonus category; non-bonus purchases earn the card's default rate. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_002]

Rho-Bank's valid rewards categories are Travel, Software, Media, Green, Sustainable, Operations, Transportation, Groceries, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Shopping, and Other; 'Other' covers transactions that fall under card-specific exclusions or exceptions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]

A vehicle/truck dealership is not among the documented qualifying examples for the Travel bonus category (airfare, lodging, car rentals, transit, rideshare booked with providers/travel agencies), so a dealer purchase does not earn the Business Silver 10.0% travel/software rate. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Platinum's 4.0% enhanced rate applies only to Travel, software, and media advertising coding; purchases outside those categories earn 1.5%, and cash equivalents, balance transfers, and fees do not earn cash back. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Business Platinum's 4.0% rate requires merchant classification as software or cloud services; all other purchases earn 1.5%, and hardware/peripherals/on-premise equipment billed as physical goods are excluded from the enhanced rate. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Green Rewards Card pays 3.0% only at sustainable/eco-friendly merchants and 1.0% on all other eligible purchases; eligible purchase types are 'most goods and services purchased from merchants that process through standard networks' clearing under eligible merchant categories. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]

Green Rewards Card ineligible purchases are cash equivalents, balance transfers, and certain fees; motor vehicles, trucks, or equipment are not listed as ineligible. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]

Green Rewards sustainable-merchant examples include EV charging networks, public transit, renewable energy, certified green lodging, sustainable office supplies, recycling, carbon offsets, and sustainable logistics; general merchandise retailers without clear sustainable classification do not qualify (a truck dealer is not listed as a sustainable merchant type). [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_005]

Business Gold earns 2.5% on eligible operations purchases and 1.0% on all other purchases; operations examples given are vendors for software, utilities, logistics, or business services. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_002]

Business Bronze earns a flat 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases, calculated on the net transaction amount after credits or returns; redemption requires a $37 minimum rewards balance. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_002]
Business Silver earns 10.0% on eligible travel and software purchases and 1.0% on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Silver's 2x promo doubles both the 10.0% travel/software rate and the 1.0% base rate (base becomes 2.0%) for the first 6 months after account opening for accounts opened between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14; merchant category exclusions continue to apply and no enrollment is required. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Typical non-qualifying transaction types across Rho-Bank rewards programs are gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest, bank-charged insurance premiums, and returned/refunded purchases; motor-vehicle or equipment purchases are not listed. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

No per-transaction or annual cash-back earning cap is stated in any retrieved business-card document; the only numeric limits documented are credit limits and redemption minimums. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Business Platinum Rewards Card credit limits: minimum approved limit $75,000, maximum available $400,000. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_001]

Business Gold Rewards Card initial credit limits start at $37,500 and may reach $225,000; annual fee $200.00; eligibility requires personal credit score 735 and PAYDEX 67. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]

Business Silver Rewards Card approved credit limits generally range from $17,500 to $112,500; annual fee $122.50 with a first-year promotional $0 annual fee for new customers. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_001]

If a dealer purchase appears misclassified or earns an unexpected rate, Rho-Bank support can review the transaction's merchant category and adjust rewards; receipts/invoices and merchant details should be kept. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Virtual business card per-card spending limits can be set between $55 and $150,000, with optional merchant-category controls that can block categories not on the allowed list. [doc_business_credit_cards_virtual_card_management_004]

Cash-back card rewards are stored as 'points' in the backend and convert at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or credit to a Rho-Bank checking account, so a percentage rate equals cash back directly. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

open_questions: No document specifies the exact merchant category code (or Rho-Bank reward category label, e.g., Shopping vs Operations vs Other) that a motor vehicle/truck dealership transaction is assigned; category is determined by the dealer's processor coding and must be confirmed post-authorization.

No card terms document explicitly states whether motor-vehicle or heavy-equipment purchases are excluded from rewards (the referenced 'Exceptions and Exclusions' section for Business Silver was not retrievable); absence of an exclusion was found, not an affirmative statement of eligibility.

No per-transaction, per-period, or annual cash-back earning caps were documented for Business Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Green Rewards Cards — this is an absence of evidence, not a documented 'no cap' statement.
Whether a vehicle dealer will accept a $40,000 card charge, or impose a card surcharge / maximum card charge amount, is not covered in the knowledge base.
Whether a landscaping-equipment/truck dealer could qualify as an 'Operations' merchant for Business Gold's 2.5% rate is not documented.

facts_found: Green Rewards Card eligibility requires minimum personal FICO of 690 and, for established businesses, a PAYDEX threshold of 42; up to 15 employee cards can be issued with category-level controls. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_001]

Business Bronze, Business Silver, Business Gold, Business Platinum, and Green Rewards Card are cash-back cards whose backend 'points' convert at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or credit to a Rho-Bank checking account. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Credit card rewards are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole point on every purchase, across all cards and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Rho-Bank reward categories are Travel, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations (business operational expenses), Transportation (logistics, shipping, rideshare), Groceries, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Shopping, and Other (transactions falling under card-specific exclusions or exceptions). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]

Each Rho-Bank card has its own bonus categories at higher rates; purchases in non-bonus categories earn that card's default rate, and the category a merchant transaction falls into is determined by merchant coding. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019]

Card tier classifications used in internal policy docs: Business Bronze Rewards Card = Entry Tier, Business Silver Rewards Card and Green Rewards Card = Mid Tier, Business Gold Rewards Card = Premium Tier, Business Platinum Rewards Card = Elite Tier. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
